_note:
Slots for [brg_home-different]. Declared beside the fragment so a slot and its {token} ship in one commit. Generated into website/acf/ by `python3 kit/build-acf.py`; never hand-edit an acf.json. Slot names are underscore-only. Defaults are esc_html'd on fill, so write literal characters — a literal `&` and a literal `—`, never `&` or `—`.\n\nTHE

IS NOT WIRED, and this one is structural rather than awaiting anybody: it carries BOTH a hard
AND an inline marker block. No slot type can hold either — text/textarea escape them into visible markup, and html is an ACF wysiwyg that returns

-wrapped content. The field cannot express the design. Same call as careers-apply's heading. The three color plates and their three parallax rates are motion and stay as code.

body_1.label: Body copy — first paragraph
body_1.default: The restaurant industry has a reputation: long hours, high turnover, burnt-out teams. We're working to change that.

body_2.label: Body copy — second paragraph
body_2.doc: Write `—` as a literal em dash.
body_2.default: We believe the best guest experiences start with the best team experiences. When our people feel valued, supported, and genuinely stoked to come to work — that energy is contagious. You feel it the moment you walk in.

body_3.label: Body copy — third paragraph
body_3.doc: Write `—` as a literal em dash.
body_3.default: We're building something that lasts — not just great food, but great careers, great communities, and a model that proves you can do right by your people and run a great business at the same time.

hl_variant.label: Highlight animation
hl_variant.doc: How the marker highlight behind “A different kind” arrives. `h3` (default) rough hand-drawn block + ~5deg angled wipe, closest to the comps. `h1` background wipe — THE ONLY ONE THAT SURVIVES A LINE WRAP. `h0` static, no animation, which is what this mark did before. Unknown or blank renders a static painted mark, never blank. Color and padding are unchanged from the original design. Catalog: website/lab/README.md.

photo_1.label: Photo — large
photo_1.doc: The large landscape photo. Around 1600x1067. Leave empty to keep the current picture.

photo_1_tone.label: Photo — large — color
photo_1_tone.doc: Color is the default. Switch this photo to black and white when you want it that way on purpose — the photography on this site was only ever gray because the placeholder images were. Affects this photo alone.

photo_1_px.label: Photo — large — movement
photo_1_px.doc: How far this photo drifts inside its frame as you scroll. The photo is laid out taller than its frame and slides within it, so an edge never appears and it is never zoomed.

photo_1_px_dir.label: Photo — large — movement direction
photo_1_px_dir.doc: Which way this photo travels as the page scrolls. Neighboring photos set in opposite directions are what reads as depth.

photo_1_float.label: Photo — large — frame drift
photo_1_float.doc: Moves the whole frame across the section, on top of the movement inside it. Leave off for a photo that fills its section edge to edge — there is nothing behind it to reveal.

photo_1_float_dir.label: Photo — large — drift direction
photo_1_float_dir.doc: Which way this frame drifts. Set a large and a small photo in opposite directions.

section_bg.label: Section background
section_bg.doc: A pattern or photo filling the whole section, behind everything else. Leave empty for a plain color. It is cropped to fill, so the exact size does not matter. On a DARK section use a light or gray artwork — a black pattern over a black panel stays invisible however high you set the strength.

section_bg_opacity.label: Background strength
section_bg_opacity.doc: How strongly the background shows through. Low values read as texture; high values compete with the words in front of it.

section_bg_px.label: Background movement
section_bg_px.doc: Drifts the background as the page scrolls, behind the content. Off is the starting point; a pattern moving too fast pulls the eye away from the copy.
